description: This file manages execution approval policies, including normalization, loading, saving, and decision logic for execution requests, with external dependencies for cryptography, filesystem, and socket communication.

methods.name: normalizeExecHost
methods.description: Normalizes a string to a predefined set of execution host types or null.

methods.name: normalizeExecTarget
methods.description: Normalizes a string to a target type, including 'auto' or specific host types.

methods.name: toStringOrUndefined
methods.description: Converts a value to string if it is a string, otherwise undefined.

methods.name: normalizeExecSecurity
methods.description: Normalizes a string to an ExecSecurity value or null.

methods.name: normalizeExecAsk
methods.description: Normalizes a string to an ExecAsk value or null.

methods.name: resolveExecApprovalsPath
methods.description: Returns the file path for exec approvals, expanding home directory.

methods.name: resolveExecApprovalsSocketPath
methods.description: Returns the socket path for exec approvals, expanding home directory.

methods.name: mergeLegacyAgent
methods.description: Merges legacy agent allowlist entries into current agent configuration.

methods.name: ensureDir
methods.description: Ensures that the directory for a given file path exists.

methods.name: coerceAllowlistEntries
methods.description: Coerces legacy or malformed allowlist entries into proper format.

methods.name: ensureAllowlistIds
methods.description: Ensures all allowlist entries have unique IDs.

methods.name: stripAllowlistCommandText
methods.description: Removes commandText from allowlist entries.

methods.name: sanitizeExecApprovalPolicy
methods.description: Sanitizes policy objects, ensuring valid values.

methods.name: normalizeExecApprovals
methods.description: Normalizes the entire ExecApprovalsFile object.

methods.name: mergeExecApprovalsSocketDefaults
methods.description: Merges socket defaults into normalized ExecApprovalsFile.

methods.name: generateToken
methods.description: Generates a new random token string.

methods.name: readExecApprovalsSnapshot
methods.description: Reads the current exec approvals snapshot from disk.

methods.name: loadExecApprovals
methods.description: Loads the exec approvals configuration from disk.

methods.name: saveExecApprovals
methods.description: Saves the exec approvals configuration to disk.

methods.name: ensureExecApprovals
methods.description: Ensures that exec approvals configuration exists and is valid.

methods.name: resolveExecApprovals
methods.description: Resolves effective exec approval settings for an agent.

methods.name: resolveExecApprovalsFromFile
methods.description: Resolves exec approval settings from a given file object.

methods.name: requiresExecApproval
methods.description: Determines if an execution request requires approval based on parameters.

methods.name: hasDurableExecApproval
methods.description: Checks if a command has durable approval in allowlist.

methods.name: buildDurableCommandApprovalPattern
methods.description: Builds a pattern string for durable command approval based on command text.

methods.name: hasExactCommandDurableExecApproval
methods.description: Checks if an exact command is durably approved.

methods.name: hasSegmentDurableExecApproval
methods.description: Checks if all segment allowlist entries are durably approved.

methods.name: recordAllowlistUse
methods.description: Records usage of an allowlist entry, updating last used info.

methods.name: buildAllowlistEntryMatchKey
methods.description: Builds a key string for matching allowlist entries.

methods.name: recordAllowlistMatchesUse
methods.description: Records usage for multiple allowlist matches.

methods.name: addAllowlistEntry
methods.description: Adds a new allowlist entry to the configuration.

methods.name: addDurableCommandApproval
methods.description: Adds a durable approval for a specific command.

methods.name: persistAllowAlwaysPatterns
methods.description: Persists allow-always patterns derived from command segments.

methods.name: minSecurity
methods.description: Returns the minimum (most restrictive) of two security levels.

methods.name: maxAsk
methods.description: Returns the maximum (most permissive) of two ask levels.

methods.name: resolveExecApprovalAllowedDecisions
methods.description: Resolves allowed decisions based on ask value.

methods.name: resolveExecApprovalRequestAllowedDecisions
methods.description: Resolves explicitly allowed decisions, considering overrides.

methods.name: isExecApprovalDecisionAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a decision is allowed given current ask setting.

methods.name: requestExecApprovalViaSocket
methods.description: Requests execution approval via a socket connection.
